title: RoleRequest
description: The fields the Stack reads on every OpenAI-shaped request to /v1/*: `model` names a role (chat, embed, stt, tts, image, ...) or an installed model id; the rest is passed to the engine unchanged. Declared here so Home builds requests against one shape; moves to shared/spec at the refocus's 0c.

model.description: A role id (`chat`, `coding`, `judge`, `router`, `embed`, `rerank`, `vision`, `stt`, `tts`, `wakeword`, `image`, `video`, `music`) or an installed model id.

quality.description: Generator roles only: which of the tiered models the sizing profile installed.
